en.name: International Freight Forwarding
en.strap: Air and ocean, import and export, planned together.
en.intro: Coordinate air and ocean imports and exports with the routing, paperwork and cost visibility each movement needs.
en.scope: International forwarding requirements differ by direction, cargo type, Incoterm and destination. We evaluate options before confirming an offer.
en.process: Share cargo specifications and trade terms; review routes, carrier options and documentation; agree on scope and milestones.
en.audience: Importers, exporters and businesses managing cross-border cargo.
en.proof: A quotation clarifies inclusions, exclusions, cost basis and expected milestones before shipment confirmation.

id.name: International Freight Forwarding
id.strap: Udara dan laut, impor dan ekspor, direncanakan bersama.
id.intro: Koordinasi impor dan ekspor udara maupun laut berdasarkan kebutuhan rute, dokumen, dan transparansi biaya.
id.scope: Kebutuhan forwarding berbeda menurut arah pengiriman, jenis barang, Incoterm, dan tujuan. Opsi dievaluasi sebelum penawaran dikonfirmasi.
id.process: Sampaikan spesifikasi barang serta trade terms; tinjau rute, carrier, dan dokumen; sepakati cakupan serta tahapan pengiriman.
id.audience: Importir, eksportir, dan perusahaan dengan kebutuhan pengiriman lintas negara.
id.proof: Penawaran menjelaskan komponen biaya, pengecualian, serta tahapan estimasi sebelum shipment dikonfirmasi.

en.name: Customs Brokerage
en.intro: Plan import and export customs documentation and clearance coordination with careful attention to applicable requirements.
en.scope: Document readiness, HS classification review, customs declarations and clearance coordination through appropriately authorised parties where required.
en.process: Review commercial documents, identify declarations and permits, coordinate filings and address customs responses.
en.audience: Businesses requiring customs document review and clearance coordination.
en.proof: Specific declarant responsibilities, permits, import restrictions and licence requirements must be confirmed before commitment.

id.name: Customs Brokerage
id.intro: Perencanaan dokumen dan koordinasi clearance impor maupun ekspor dengan mempertimbangkan ketentuan yang berlaku.
id.scope: Kesiapan dokumen, peninjauan HS code, deklarasi kepabeanan, dan koordinasi clearance melalui pihak yang berwenang bila diperlukan.
id.process: Periksa dokumen komersial, tentukan deklarasi serta izin yang diperlukan, koordinasikan filing dan tanggapan kepabeanan.
id.audience: Perusahaan yang membutuhkan pemeriksaan dokumen dan koordinasi clearance.
id.proof: Tanggung jawab deklaran, perizinan dan pembatasan barang harus dikonfirmasi sebelum penugasan.

en.name: 3PL & Warehousing
en.strap: Storage planned around how goods move in and out.
en.intro: Build practical warehouse and third-party logistics arrangements around storage, handling and order-flow requirements.
en.scope: Storage feasibility, inbound receiving, inventory processes, pick-and-pack, fulfilment and dispatch coordination subject to facility and partner confirmation.
en.process: Review product characteristics, space needs, throughput, system visibility and fulfilment SLA expectations.
en.audience: Businesses planning inventory storage and fulfilment operations.
en.proof: Warehouse capacity, site suitability, safety conditions and pricing are verified against the actual proposal.

id.name: 3PL & Warehousing
id.strap: Penyimpanan yang direncanakan menurut arus barang masuk dan keluar.
id.intro: Perencanaan pergudangan dan third-party logistics sesuai kebutuhan storage, handling, dan pemrosesan pesanan.
id.scope: Evaluasi ruang simpan, penerimaan barang, pengelolaan stok, pick-and-pack, fulfilment dan dispatch sesuai konfirmasi fasilitas serta mitra.
id.process: Tinjau karakter barang, kebutuhan kapasitas, volume pergerakan, visibilitas stok dan ekspektasi SLA.
id.audience: Perusahaan yang merencanakan operasional penyimpanan dan fulfilment.
id.proof: Kapasitas, kesesuaian fasilitas, keamanan dan harga harus diverifikasi berdasarkan proposal aktual.

en.name: Domestic Distribution
en.strap: Full truck, part load or container, matched to the cargo.
en.intro: Plan intercity and domestic distribution through full-truck, part-load, containerised and air cargo options.
en.scope: FTL, LTL, FCL, LCL and domestic air freight; pickup, handling, transport coordination and delivery arrangements as applicable.
en.process: Evaluate cargo dimensions, origin/destination, delivery constraints, consolidation options and mode-specific handovers.
en.audience: Businesses moving goods within Indonesia using road, sea or air distribution.
en.proof: Equipment availability, origin–destination coverage, cargo acceptance and delivery commitments are confirmed per inquiry.

id.name: Domestic Distribution
id.strap: Truk penuh, muatan gabungan atau kontainer, sesuai barangnya.
id.intro: Perencanaan distribusi domestik melalui charter truk, konsolidasi, kontainer, dan kargo udara.
id.scope: FTL, LTL, FCL, LCL serta air freight domestik; pengambilan, penanganan, koordinasi angkutan dan pengantaran sesuai kebutuhan.
id.process: Tinjau dimensi barang, rute, batasan waktu, opsi konsolidasi dan serah terima sesuai moda.
id.audience: Perusahaan dengan kebutuhan distribusi antarkota di Indonesia.
id.proof: Ketersediaan unit, cakupan rute, ketentuan penerimaan barang dan komitmen pengiriman dikonfirmasi per inquiry.

en.name: Project Cargo
en.strap: Complex cargo calls for technical planning.
en.intro: For heavy, oversized and specialised cargo, the route, lifting interface and risk controls should be considered before the movement begins.
en.scope: Feasibility evaluation for out-of-gauge, heavy-lift, breakbulk and multimodal movements, subject to drawings, survey and partner validation.
en.process: Review cargo drawings and weight, transport geometry, lifting/lashing concepts, route and schedule feasibility.
en.audience: Industrial equipment and non-standard cargo requiring technical coordination.
en.proof: Proposed handling methods and permits remain conditional on engineering, surveys and actual provider capability.

id.name: Project Cargo
id.intro: Untuk barang berat, oversized, dan khusus, rute, metode pengangkatan, serta kontrol risiko perlu dipastikan sebelum bergerak.
id.scope: Evaluasi OOG, heavy-lift, breakbulk dan multimoda berdasarkan gambar teknis, survei dan validasi mitra.
id.process: Tinjau drawing, berat, dimensi angkutan, metode lifting/lashing, kelayakan rute dan jadwal.
id.audience: Pengiriman peralatan industri dan barang nonstandar yang membutuhkan koordinasi teknis.
id.proof: Metode handling dan izin merupakan hasil studi teknis, survei dan konfirmasi kapabilitas provider.

id: Sea Import
Impor laut melalui kontainer dan konsolidasi dengan koordinasi pelabuhan.
Pilihan FCL/LCL, bill of lading, origin/destination charges, customs dan koordinasi transportasi lanjutan.

Outbound air cargo planned for destination and documentation requirements.
Export cargo acceptance, packing review, airwaybill coordination, screening and flight options.

id: Air Export
Pengiriman ekspor udara sesuai tujuan serta kebutuhan dokumen.
Penerimaan cargo, pemeriksaan kemasan, koordinasi airwaybill, screening dan pilihan penerbangan.

Outbound ocean shipping options for containerised and consolidated cargo.
FCL/LCL planning, container suitability, cut-offs, bill of lading and export document requirements.

id: Sea Export
Pengiriman ekspor laut melalui kontainer maupun konsolidasi.

en: FTL · Full Truckload
Dedicated truck movement when a load needs its own vehicle.
Vehicle body and capacity, pickup/delivery windows, routing, loading constraints and POD.

id: FTL · Full Truckload
Pengiriman dengan satu truk khusus sesuai kebutuhan muatan.

en: LTL · Less Than Truckload
Part-load road distribution where consolidation can improve efficiency.
Chargeable weight/volume, consolidation points, handling and estimated delivery windows.

id: LTL · Less Than Truckload
Distribusi part-load dengan opsi konsolidasi muatan.
Perhitungan berat/volume, titik konsolidasi, handling dan estimasi waktu pengiriman.
vora-visual-62.webp

en: FCL · Full Container Load
Domestic container shipping for full-container requirements.
Container type, port pairs, container handling, freight schedule and onward delivery.
vora-visual-65.webp
id: FCL · Full Container Load
Pengiriman domestik menggunakan satu kontainer penuh.
Tipe kontainer, rute antarpelabuhan, handling, jadwal kapal dan pengantaran lanjutan.

en: LCL · Less Than Container Load
Domestic sea consolidation for shipments that do not require a full container.
Cargo measurement, consolidation timetable, cargo acceptance, port-to-port and delivery scope.
vora-visual-67.webp
id: LCL · Less Than Container Load
Konsolidasi laut domestik untuk muatan yang tidak memerlukan satu kontainer penuh.
Pengukuran muatan, jadwal konsolidasi, ketentuan barang, port-to-port dan pengantaran.
vora-visual-67.webp

en: Domestic Air Freight
Air distribution between domestic airports when transit speed is a key variable.
Chargeable weight, flight uplift, cargo security checks, airport handling and final-mile arrangements.
vora-visual-68.webp
id: Air Freight Domestik
Pengiriman antarabandara domestik ketika waktu menjadi pertimbangan utama.
Chargeable weight, ruang penerbangan, pemeriksaan keamanan, handling bandara dan last-mile.

en.home_intro: VORA coordinates international and domestic freight for importers, exporters and companies that ship within Indonesia. Each job starts with a written scope that says who does what.
en.home_service: Tell us what you ship and where it goes.
en.home_process: How an inquiry becomes a shipment.
en.home_process_body: Tell us what moves, where it needs to go, and when. We evaluate the requirements, propose an appropriate approach, and coordinate the next steps.
en.why_title: Each shipment gets its own plan.
en.why_body: Every shipment is different. Scope, timelines and responsibility should be explicit before commitments are made.
en.about_title: A clear plan before the cargo moves.
en.about_body: VORA is a freight and logistics brand of PT Satu Arah International. Our approach starts with understanding cargo, trade lanes and delivery constraints. Operational capabilities and available coverage are confirmed per inquiry.
en.solutions_title: Solutions shaped around real cargo needs.
en.network_title: We confirm coverage for each inquiry.
en.network_body: Share your origin, destination and requirements. Available lanes and service partners are confirmed during inquiry.
en.services_title: Choose the service around the shipment.

id.home_intro: VORA mengoordinasikan pengiriman internasional dan domestik untuk importir, eksportir, dan perusahaan yang mengirim di dalam negeri. Setiap pekerjaan dimulai dari cakupan tertulis yang menyebut siapa mengerjakan apa.
id.home_service: Beri tahu kami barang yang dikirim dan tujuannya.
id.home_process_body: Informasikan jenis barang, asal, tujuan, dan jadwalnya. Kami meninjau kebutuhan, mengusulkan pendekatan, dan mengoordinasikan langkah berikutnya.
id.why_body: Setiap pengiriman memiliki karakter berbeda. Cakupan, jadwal, dan penanggung jawab perlu jelas sejak awal.
id.about_title: Rencana pengiriman yang jelas sejak awal.
id.about_body: VORA adalah brand freight dan logistik dari PT Satu Arah International. Pendekatan kami dimulai dari memahami barang, jalur perdagangan dan batasan pengiriman. Kapabilitas serta jangkauan layanan dikonfirmasi untuk setiap permintaan.
id.network_title: Jangkauan layanan kami konfirmasi untuk setiap permintaan.
id.network_body: Berikan asal, tujuan dan kebutuhan Anda. Ketersediaan jalur dan mitra layanan akan dikonfirmasi dalam proses inquiry.
